sub_graphs.title: EIP-2003: EVMC Precompile Execution Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the execution flow when a precompiled contract is called through an EVMC module

nodes.label: EVMC Call Message Received
nodes.description: The EVMC module has received a call message for execution

nodes.label: Validate Message Type
nodes.description: Check that message type is EVMC_CALL (not CREATE or other types)

nodes.label: Message Type Invalid
nodes.description: Message type is not EVMC_CALL; must reject

nodes.label: Validate Destination Address
nodes.description: Check if destination address is within EIP-1352 precompile ranges

nodes.label: Address Not a Precompile
nodes.description: Destination is not in precompile range; emulate empty code execution

nodes.label: Validate No Code Provided
nodes.description: Check that code argument is NULL and code size is 0

nodes.label: Code Provided Error
nodes.description: Code was provided but precompiles do not accept code; must reject

nodes.label: Validation Passed
nodes.description: All validation checks passed; ready for precompile execution

external_entities.name: Ethereum Client
external_entities.description: The Ethereum client calling the EVMC module to execute a precompile

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2003: Precompile Gas Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation and deduction for precompile execution

nodes.label: Precompile Ready for Execution
nodes.description: Validation passed, precompile is ready to execute

nodes.label: Calculate Gas Cost
nodes.description: Compute gas cost from input data according to precompile-specific formula

nodes.label: Check Gas Availability
nodes.description: Compare calculated cost against gas limit; compute remaining gas

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Gas cost exceeds gas limit; return EVMC_OUT_OF_GAS

nodes.label: Gas Sufficient
nodes.description: Gas limit covers cost; remaining gas calculated

nodes.label: Execute Precompile Logic
nodes.description: Run the actual precompile computation

nodes.label: Execution Success
nodes.description: Precompile executed successfully; EVMC_SUCCESS with output and gas remaining

nodes.label: Execution Failure
nodes.description: Precompile failed (non-gas reason); EVMC_FAILURE returned

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2003: EVMC Error Code Handling
sub_graphs.description: Models the error codes returned by EVMC precompile modules

nodes.label: EVMC Processing Call
nodes.description: EVMC module is processing a call message

nodes.label: Determine Execution Result
nodes.description: Evaluate the outcome of validation or execution

nodes.label: Return EVMC_REJECTED
nodes.description: Validation failed; call rejected before execution

nodes.label: Return EVMC_OUT_OF_GAS
nodes.description: Gas limit insufficient for precompile execution

nodes.label: Return EVMC_SUCCESS
nodes.description: Precompile executed successfully with output data and remaining gas

nodes.label: Return EVMC_FAILURE
nodes.description: Non-gas-related failure during precompile execution

nodes.label: Return EVMC_REVERT
nodes.description: Precompile reverted; unspent gas preserved

nodes.label: Return Empty Code Result
nodes.description: Non-precompile address; return EVMC_SUCCESS with full gas intact

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail which precompile addresses are within the EIP-1352 ranges
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-1352 ranges are 0x01-0x09 for current precompiles, with future precompiles in a defined range

ambiguities.text: The distinction between when to return EVMC_FAILURE vs EVMC_REVERT is not clearly specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EVMC_FAILURE is for hard errors (invalid input), EVMC_REVERT is for logical failures where gas should be preserved

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'emulate empty code execution' is used without specifying exact behavior
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume empty code execution means returning EVMC_SUCCESS immediately with full gas limit and empty output

implicit_assumptions.description: The EVMC module correctly implements the precompile logic without introducing bugs
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect precompile implementation could lead to consensus failures or vulnerabilities

implicit_assumptions.description: The Host interface (evmc_context) is truly not needed by precompile implementations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Precompiles requiring host access would fail or behave incorrectly when context is NULL

implicit_assumptions.description: All EVMC modules use compatible ABI version 6 as specified
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: ABI mismatch could cause crashes or incorrect behavior
